[[File:Reflections-III-fig-10.png|40px]]

A '''Defensive Shield''' is a [[Star Wars CCG]] card type introduced in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] (31 October 2001).<ref name="ref3-rules">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/reflectionsiiirules.pdf Reflections III Rules Supplement], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005192128/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/reflectionsiiirules.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Cards with the Gungan Warrior Shield icon are Defensive Shields. They are played from a pile under a [[Starting Effect]] and do not count against the 60-card deck. Replica titles of earlier Effects are a different card type; the unique and restricted rule still ties them together.
